title: What If the Sun Disappeared Right Now?
description:
What if the Sun vanished right now? For eight minutes, Earth would remain in light and orbit.

Gravity and light propagate at the exact same speed: the speed of light. Once the propagation delay passes, Earth would go dark and fly off in a straight tangent line into space.
